d: In this video, Firstpost explores how a 14-hour overnight train journey in India became a memorable experience for Japanese content creator Miyu. Travelling from Udaipur to Agra in an air-conditioned 3-tier coach, Miyu shared glimpses of her journey, describing it as a bucket-list experience. While she found the train comfortable and safe, she had one complaint: the freezing cold! Her video sparked warm reactions online, with Indians welcoming her and suggesting places to visit.
